preconditions.description: The length of the input string S is between 1 and 14, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in S)
preconditions.description: The input string S contains only hexadecimal digits (0-9, a-f).
At least one character in S is non-zero.

postconditions.expression: output == 'NO' or (len(output) == len(S) and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in output))
postconditions.description: The output is either 'NO' or a hexadecimal string of the same length as S, containing only hexadecimal digits.

If the output is not 'NO', then the numerical value of the output string is the smallest possible value such that the absolute difference between the numerical value of the input string S and the output string is equal to the numerical_difference.

postconditions.expression: output == 'NO' or (int(S, 16) - int(output, 16) == numerical_difference and all(output.count(c) == S.count(c) for c in '0123456789abcdef'))
postconditions.description: If the output is not 'NO', then the output string is a permutation of the input string S.
